nodes.text: With one final stroke, Erik's ax splits the log cleanly in two!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! I did it!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Yup. Good split.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: ...Where's the rest?
Erik looks over to Mr. Horner's pile, where the old man has split 12 logs in the time it took Erik to split one!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... I was going for quality over quantity...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: ...But this was a good talk.
Mr. Horner turns and leaves the barn, his pail sloshing heavy with milk. Erik pets the cow in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think that went well, don't you, Penelope?
After a time, Mr. Horner rises from his stool.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I'm gonna go get another pail.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: That's my girl.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I taught her to always stand up for herself.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It shows!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Are you saying... I'm beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! I mean... I suppose you have a rugged charm, but... Uh... Nevermind.
Mr. Horner just glares at him. Erik clears his throat and trails off.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Well? How is it she reminds you of me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She, uh... Dresses similarly! A lot of earthy colors. Do you guys coordinate that?
Mr. Horner just glares at him. Erik clears his throat and trails off.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gotta keep the conversation going...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, about Delilah... She reminds me of you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: How's that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She's...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: You're seriously asking me `that` while you're trying to date my only daughter?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're seriously asking me [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] while you're trying to date my only daughter?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... No, sir, I am not.
Erik turns his eyes back to his milk pail, filling it quietly.
Mr. Horner shrugs.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Live it the way you want, I guess. Don't back down to anybody else.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Simple. Poignant. I like it!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: ...Advice about what?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Advice about... Um... Starting conversations?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Oh... Nope.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... All right, then.
Erik turns his eyes back to his milk pail, filling it quietly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I should try to keep him talking...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So... Do you have any advice about...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Nope. Way back, I was supposed to take over the family business.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh really? What was the family business?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Squash farming.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love squashes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Er... But not as much as pumpkins!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: That's what I told my Pa. He wasn't happy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: ...But I still went my own way.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, it's a good thing you did! You're great at what you do!
Before long...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'What's the deal'?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Pumpkins make people happy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: You gotta problem with `happiness?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You gotta problem with [color=#e23b3b][i]happiness?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, sir!
The two continue in awkward silence...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: You say something?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, nope!
The two continue in awkward silence...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Glad I could help.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just hope our boy Erik is doing all right with Mr. Horner...
You are now playing as Erik.
You follow Mr. Horner into a cool, shady barn.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not sure what happened back at the wood pile. I'm usually very rugged...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Don't matter much.
A low chorus of moos sounds from around Erik, and he realizes he is surrounded by cows.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ah! I've always thought that I might be more suited for animal husbandry!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: As long as the animal's `real` husband doesn't object!
nodes.text_bbcode: As long as the animal's [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] husband doesn't object!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Delilah might do some baking. I suspect she'll need some milk. Pull up a stool beside Penelope.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure... Hello there, Penelope.
Eric takes a seat by the brown, doe-eyed cow in front of him while Mr. Horner settles in beside the spotted Holstein in the next stall.
The two milk their cows in silence, filling their buckets with out a word.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now's my chance to get on Mr. Horner's good side... I should probably start a conversation...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, Mr. Horner... I realize we know so little about each other. Tell me...

options.label: Did you always want to be a pumpkin farmer?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Potatoes?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes, potatoes. You've just gotta keep busy to get your mind off things.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now put these in a pot, we've gotta boil them til they're soft!
Before long, Spencer and Allison are leaning over a big bowl, mashing potatoes side by side.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See? You're a pro!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No I'm not! Mashing potatoes is not a viable profession.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, it `could` be, with your talent!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] be, with your talent!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee hee... Thanks, Spencer. This is fun. And relaxing in an odd way.
Score Up!
Spencer pounds his fist into his palm.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That would teach that pretty boy to mess with the Troublemakers, eh?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Your offer of violent revenge is very gallant, but I'm afraid it would not help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It would only make me think about how upset he made me... How childish he made me feel...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I don't want to think of him `at all`.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I don't want to think of him [color=#3b78e2][i]at all[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I see your point...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, maybe all you need is a task to get your mind off things.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like mashing these potatoes!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Potatoes?
Before long, Spencer and Allison are leaning over a big bowl, mashing potatoes side by side.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See? You're a pro!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No I'm not! Mashing potatoes is not a viable profession.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, it `could` be, with your talent!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] be, with your talent!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee hee... Thanks, Spencer. This is fun. And relaxing in an odd way.
In the far corner of the kitchen, Spencer notices $ALLISON staring blankly into space...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey. You've been peeling the same potato for five minutes now... I think it's pretty peeled.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh!
Allison looks down at her pale, whittled-down potato, shaved to the size of a golf ball!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose I'm still a bit distracted.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Still thinking about that Cameron jerk?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know what would help? If we...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine by me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Me too.
Owen and Paige each snatch an egg in their fist, still grumbling to themselves with anger...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Show `you` a monopoly...
nodes.text_bbcode: Show [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] a monopoly...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pssh. 'Head cheerleader'...
They each smash their eggs on the edge of a bowl with way too much force, sending yolk and eggshells flying!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ick!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, you guys are way too angry to be handling eggs. Why don't you tenderize the meat or something?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Maybe that's for the best...
Spencer hands them meat tenderizers and leaves them to their work.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine by me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Me too.
Owen and Paige take meat tenderizers and begin pounding on thin cuts of beef, grumbling to themselves all the while...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Show `you` a monopoly...
nodes.text_bbcode: Show [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] a monopoly...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pssh. 'Head cheerleader'...
But angry as they seem, they keep to themselves!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, at least they're taking their anger out on meat and not each other.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'll keep that in mind.
As Delilah goes about her tasks, Spencer notices Owen and Paige bickering. Gripping his crutches, he makes his way over to them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're just being petty.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Petty? What, you can't believe that Lee was a much better date than you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're just hyping it up after hearing what a good time Maria and I had!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You and your head cheerleader don't own the monopoly on fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa! What are you two arguing about?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige thinks she and her date had a better time at Homecoming than me and Maria. Which is ridiculous, right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're fighting over who had the most `fun?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're fighting over who had the most [color=#e23b3b][i]fun?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Can't you do something useful with all that anger?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like what, Master Chef?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Space? From me? Are you saying I'm annoying or something?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Omigosh, I'm being annoying, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm so embarrassed! I'll be over there...
Kimi hangs her head and trudges away to begin her work.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks for stepping in, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No problem. Kimi can be kinda intense, but really she just wants to help.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wish I handled that better, though. Broke it to her more gently, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Onions? Right now? But--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sure Delilah will fill us in later. But we got a lot of work to do. Like Coach says, hustle now, flap your gums later!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All right, all right. Later then, Delilah!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Uh huh...
Kimi walks off, finding a space to work across the kitchen. Delilah breathes a sigh of relief.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks, Spencer.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't mention it. Kimi can be kinda intense. But really, she just wants to help.
Erik hacks wildly, swinging like a madman, sending wood chips flying!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hff... Hff...
Out of breath, Erik steps back to observe his work...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...And finds the log still in one piece, though mangled and covered in shallow cuts!
Erik looks to Delilah. She shoots him a smile and a discreet thumbs up.
They part ways, Delilah leading the other Troublemakers into the house.
Meanwhile, Erik follows Mr. Horner to the side of the house, where a stacked pyramid of logs sits.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: You ever chop wood before?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've played 'Tap Tap Log Tycoon' on my phone... Does that count?
Mr. Horner just snorts and tosses Erik a surprisingly heavy ax. He sets a log on his chopping block, and Erik does the same.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Just hit it dead center. You'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Dead center... I can do this...
Erik lifts the ax and swings it down with all his might, hitting the log...

nodes.prompt: Where do you hit the log?
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: `I'll` take care of my daughter. You just need you to 'take care' of dinner.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'll[/i][/color] take care of my daughter. You just need you to 'take care' of dinner.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That... That came out wrong!
Delilah whispers harshly to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Erik, I meant offer to go help him!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What I meant was, I will take care of your daughter by keeping her warm!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not with cuddling, I mean with fire!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not setting `her` on fire, I mean wood! Wood that I will help you chop!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not setting [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] on fire, I mean wood! Wood that I will help you chop!

nodes.text: Mr. Horner eyes Erik suspiciously for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Suit yourself.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'd be glad to lend assistance with your... You know, farm chores.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean, not 'chores'! Chores are for kids! And we're `men`! Two manly farm men. Doing man-chores!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, not 'chores'! Chores are for kids! And we're [color=#e23b3b][i]men[/i][/color]! Two manly farm men. Doing man-chores!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Sure. Could always use a hand.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: My dad was watching you like a hawk on that porch!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Like... A concerned but friendly hawk?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: No... Like a protective papa hawk.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's the scariest kind of hawk!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I know! I'm not sure he's taking kindly to you... I think he was out there to make sure you didn't kiss me goodnight...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That was an option?!
Delilah blushes...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: That's why it's so important for you to impress him today! If he likes you... He might actually consent to letting us... You know... `Date.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's why it's so important for you to impress him today! If he likes you... He might actually consent to letting us... You know... [color=#3b78e2][i]Date.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik and Delilah rejoin the rest of the group.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: ...But for that to happen, tonight's meal has to be absolutely `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But for that to happen, tonight's meal has to be absolutely [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: 'Perfect'?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're right... I'll do whatever it takes!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I knew I could count on you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You can count on us to help too!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... As long as free food is still part of this deal.
A creak of wood signals the front door opening behind Delilah.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Here he comes!
Mr. Horner exits the house and walks out to meet the Troublemakers, giving them a curt nod.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mr. Horner!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thank you for having us over for Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, we all appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Yup. Same.
The Troublemakers wait for more of a response... But none comes. After a moment, Mr. Horner finally speaks again.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Delilah, you need help with dinner?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Nope! I've got it all under control!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We'll be there to assist you as well, Delilah!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! I can help out too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You, Spence?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't strike me as the domestic type.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I've had to whip up a few snacks while watching TV. After watching every marathon of Wrestlefest 5000, I've learned a thing or two!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't think melting nacho cheese counts as culinary skill.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I'll leave y'all to it, then. Gonna see about some firewood.
As Mr. Horner walks off, Delilah nudges Erik with her elbow.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Erik, don't you think you should say something? This would be a good chance to impress my dad!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, right!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mr. Horner! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Hmm?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just wanted to say...

options.label: I'll take good care of your daughter.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Everyone knows I wouldn't hurt a fly! Without flies, there'd be no fly-swatter industry!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Of course `I` know you're a sweet guy... But it's different when it comes to my dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] know you're a sweet guy... But it's different when it comes to my dad.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You're dating his only daughter! His little girl! His darling Lilah-Bear!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I'm the most non-threatening guy I know! If Mr. Horner really objected to me seeing you, he would have said something, right?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Trust me, he did. Only he said it with his `eyes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me, he did. Only he said it with his [color=#3b78e2][i]eyes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That whole time we were saying goodbye, he never once shouted at me or ridiculed me or shooed me away with a broom, so I'd call it a success!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You don't know my dad like I do. He's a really quiet person. He may not have said anything aloud... But he said it with his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What makes you say that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't you remember the last time I saw your dad?
Days earlier...
Erik walks Delilah down the dirt road from the bus stop to her front porch.
As they reach the door, Delilah turns to him, smiling shyly.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks for walking me back to my house. I usually don't get home so late, but 4H Club ran extra long today.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My pleasure. I had a great time walking with you... But then again, I always have a great time with you.
Delilah smiles, a rosy color flushing to her cheeks. She looks into Erik's eyes, when suddenly...
`SHHHK! SHHHK! SHHHK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SHHHK! SHHHK! SHHHK![/b]

nodes.text: Just then, a scraping noise sounds from the porch beside them! The two stop in their tracks!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What was that?

The two turn to find Delilah's father in a rocking chair at the far end of the porch, his face half-shrouded in shadow. In his hands he holds a small block of wood, whittling away at it with a long, gleaming knife!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: D...Daddy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mr. Horner! Good evening! Didn't see you there!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Go on inside, Delilah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He's right, it's getting a little chilly out here.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Best get going, son.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good idea! Can't be wandering around after dark! G'night Delilah! See ya, Mr. Horner!
Erik turns and walks away, whistling a jaunty tune. All the while, Mr. Horner watches Erik with locked, scowling eyes...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think that memory should reassure you.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: How, exactly?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Clearly, your dad thinks I'm...
Erik wraps his arms around Delilah. He squeezes her, and she squeezes back with a giggle.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee, Erik! You know my dad is strict! What if he saw us?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I couldn't help it! You smell like flowers!
Delilah grins and blushes, but steps away, looking over her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, we have nothing to worry about!
Erik leans in, lips puckered... But Delilah backs away in shock!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Erik! What are you doing! My dad's just inside! What if he saw us?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But... I thought there was nothing to worry about!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What about you, Daddy?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I'm thankful for this perfect dinner.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Perfect? But I ruined the turkey! I was hoping to make a delicious dinner just like Mom always made for you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: They weren't always delicious. Your mom burnt the first five turkeys she ever made.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: She did?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: To a crisp. But food's not what makes a dinner perfect. It's the `people.`
nodes.text_bbcode: To a crisp. But food's not what makes a dinner perfect. It's the [color=#e23b3b][i]people.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: And it looks like you've gathered a fine group of people here today.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: And this one...
Mr. Horner points a thumb at Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: ...He's a tough kid. I like 'im.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Delilah stands and wraps her arms around her father in a tight hug.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Tough'? Are we still talking about Erik here?
Later that night...
The Troublemakers say their goodbyes as they make their way back to Owen's truck.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks again, Mr. Horner!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Delilah

nodes.text: 'See you around'? Does that mean he's gonna hunt me down?

nodes.speaker: Delilah

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Goodnight, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Best. Thanksgiving. Ever.

nodes.text_bbcode: You mean my [color=#e23b3b][i]Drunken Style Chicken Surprise?[/i][/color] I made that up while watching kung fu movies.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And this `poulet cordon bleu?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And this [color=#3b78e2][i]poulet cordon bleu?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Bodyslam Bird with Cheese.` Perfect when watching wrestling.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Bodyslam Bird with Cheese.[/i][/color] Perfect when watching wrestling.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Spencer, you made a perfect `boeuf a la bourguinon!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer, you made a perfect [color=#3b78e2][i]boeuf a la bourguinon![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's just `Gridiron Beef-Splosion,` my gameday specialty!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's just [color=#e23b3b][i]Gridiron Beef-Splosion,[/i][/color] my gameday specialty!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I give up. I haven't eaten this well since I was rich. I'm just gonna sit back and enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Amen to that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm definitely thankful for all the food and friendship in the room right now, and for the Horners' hospitality...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Anyone? `'Thankful'?` That was a cue, people!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Anyone? [color=#3b78e2][i]'Thankful'?[/i][/color] That was a cue, people!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh... Are we really doing the 'what are we thankful for' thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Yes.` So stop acting tough and let yourself be corny for a minute!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes.[/i][/color] So stop acting tough and let yourself be corny for a minute!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if Paige is too stubborn, I'll start.
Owen and Paige both look up from their plates. Their eyes meet for just a moment...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm thankful that we can sit down and put our problems aside. Together. At least for a while.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um... All of us, that is!
Paige hides the beginnings of a smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... Put me down for what he said.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I'm thankful for sports radio, good cooking oil, and for you guys. Every last one of ya.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And that's as sappy as I'm gonna get.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm thankful for our camaraderie, and for the relief it grants me from all my trivial worries...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...And also for `mashed potatoes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And also for [color=#3b78e2][i]mashed potatoes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What about you, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me? That's easy. I'm thankful for...
You are now playing as Spencer.
Back in the kitchen, Spencer and $ALLISON put the finishing touches on a pot of soup...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right... Now, just a little more seasoning.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How much hot sauce should I add? A dash?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: As much as you're brave enough for!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Two` dashes!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Two[/i][/color] dashes!

nodes.text: The two share a laugh as $ALLISON adds the seasoning to the pot.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think you were right, Spencer. Keeping busy was just what I needed.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm impressed, Spencer! You really pulled this team together!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You even got Owen and Paige to stop fighting for a minute!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess hitting meat with a spiky hammer is a great way to blow off some steam.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. For the record though, I probably tenderized a little better than Owen did.
Just then, Spencer notices Delilah pacing nervously. He sidles over to her.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Potatoes are done... Yams are done... What am I forgetting? Come on, think, think, think...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Everything all right, Delilah? You look like you're stressing out!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I am! I just wanted everything to go right for this dinner...
The rest of the Troublemakers gather to see what the matter is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's just dinner, Delilah. I'm sure everything will be fine.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It's more than that! I just... I'm too embarrassed to say.
Kimi puts a hand on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't have to be embarrassed. Whatever it is, we're all here to help.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well... Before my mom passed away, `she` was the one in charge of Thanksgiving dinners. My dad was always at his happiest when he was sitting down for her cooking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Before my mom passed away, [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] was the one in charge of Thanksgiving dinners. My dad was always at his happiest when he was sitting down for her cooking.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: My parents always told me they fell in love over the perfect home-cooked meal.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I thought that if I made a good enough dinner, my dad would be more lenient, and Erik and I...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Not that I wanted Erik to fall in `love` with me! I just... Like him a lot, is all...
nodes.text_bbcode: Not that I wanted Erik to fall in [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] with me! I just... Like him a lot, is all...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awwww... That is so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It's been weighing on my mind... I'm afraid it's going to make me forget something!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't worry! We've got the sides done, the stuffing, the gravy, the cranberry sauce... Everything we need for a perfect Turkey Day!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Speaking of which... Where is the turkey?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: `The turkey?!` Oh no oh no oh no!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]The turkey?![/i][/color] Oh no oh no oh no!

nodes.text: Delilah rushes over to the oven and pulls open the door, letting loose a plume of dark smoke!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: `Koff! Koff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Koff! Koff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The Troublemakers rush to help her, pulling the burnt, blackened turkey out of the oven! They open the windows to air out the smoky room.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no!
Just then, the back door opens as Mr. Horner and Erik enter, sniffing curiously.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Something burning in here? Everyone okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The turkey!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, everyone...
Erik rushes to Delilah's side and puts a comforting hand on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't worry, Delilah. Everything's gonna be okay! I'm gonna do everything I can to make sure this dinner goes perfectly for you!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh, Erik... That's so sweet!
Delilah takes Erik's hand, smiling sweetly... Until Mr. Horner clears his throat loudly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: We've got a turkey out back, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: If you're serious about making this right, here's your chance.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Gulp...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You are now playing as Erik.
Mr. Horner leads Erik out to a pen at the back of his property.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: When you said you had a 'turkey' out back, you meant like a frozen turkey, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Nope.
He points to the fenced enclosure, where a lone, fat turkey waddles around, warbling.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: If we're gonna eat, you're gonna have to grab that bird.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And... And... Kill it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: That's usually how it goes, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm... Not sure I can do that, Mr. Horner.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I'm `telling` you what to do. Are you defying me in my own home?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]telling[/i][/color] you what to do. Are you defying me in my own home?

nodes.text: Erik shrinks away.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: N... No, sir!
Mr. Horner points to the pen sternly, waiting. Erik looks over to the unassuming turkey...
It stares back at him, cocking its head sideways as it gobbles curiously...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Such a noble, nonjudgmental creature!
Erik swallows, and decides to...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Erik.
The Troublemakers gather on the dirt road out in front of the Horner Farm, following Erik as he makes his way to the front gate.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for coming with me, guys. I was a little nervous when Delilah invited me over to her farm for Thanksgiving dinner.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Her dad's a pretty intense guy, but I think I've made some progress with him lately. Plus, if you guys have my back, I'm sure I'll be fine as a fiddle!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem, man. We're happy to help.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Speak for yourself, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...But I suppose I didn't have anything better to do, so here I am!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, as long as free food is involved, I'm there!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah! Besides, the six of us haven't done anything together since Homecoming!

nodes.text: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather not talk about Homecoming.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It, uh, didn't go well for you, $ALLISON?

nodes.text: Well... I for one had a `great` time at Homecoming with Lee.

nodes.text: Well, `my` night was the opposite of blast. It was a gravitational implosion. And yet here we are, still talking about it...

nodes.text: And what better way to do that than with some grub?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose so...
